title: asperula cynanchica var. jordanii
intro: Asperula cynanchica var. jordanii, commonly known as Jordan's Woodruff or Woodruff, is a plant species in the family Rubiaceae. It is a flowering plant with various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which have been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, wounds, and other health problems. The therapeutic actions of Jordan's Woodruff include astringent, antiseptic, and anti-inflammatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
